run_finetune_bert: run BERT pre-training finetuning on pregenerated data with configurable batch size, epochs, and learning rate
create_dataset_pregenerated: create a PregeneratedDataset that loads pre-generated BERT training examples from JSON files with optional memory-mapped storage
convert_example_features: convert a pre-generated BERT training example into InputFeatures with input_ids, masks, segment_ids, and label arrays
test_finetune_distributed: test distributed BERT finetuning with multi-GPU support, gradient accumulation, and fp16 mixed precision training
review_finetune_args: review the argparse CLI interface for BERT finetuning including pregenerated data path, output directory, and optimization hyperparameters
